verdict.rationale: A security-key vendor could plausibly ship official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only standards compatibility (WebAuthn/FIDO2, HID), end-user management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool) and Google's OpenSK firmware source. None of these is an official SDK for integrating the key into desktop or mobile apps, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs let me integrate the key into my own desktop and mobile apps
